metadata.protocol: Chronological step-separated 60/15/10/15 split; candidate selection on validation AP; selected candidate refit on train+validation; thresholds on calibration negatives; final test untouched. No SMOTE. Random row sampling independent of labels.
limitations: Synthetic African mobile-money benchmark, not UPI or real bank data.
Fraud labels represent simulated account takeover, not coerced payments.
Only amount, transaction type and cyclic hour are used; weak signal and simulator artifacts limit generalization.
Threshold false-positive targets apply to calibration data; later data may shift.
No raw balances, identities, post-transaction fields or fraud flags are prediction inputs.
